paymentCancelled.subject: Your payment was cancelled, {{name}}
paymentCancelled.body:
Hi {{name}},

We're sorry to inform you that the payment for your order was cancelled.

If it was a mistake, you can generate a new order from your account or contact us for further assistance.

Thanks anyway for your interest.
